decisions: Module error retryability derives from the canonical kernel ErrorKind rather than a module-local boolean, removing a competing retry taxonomy. Behaviour change: CapabilityUnavailable is now non-retryable, matching the kernel allow-list established by S00.
The golden slice injects the M04/M01/M05/M02/M03 services as ports instead of importing them, so foundation never depends on the modules that depend on it.
M01 planning services additionally accept a bare canonical ProductionGraph so the slice can drive the port without foundation importing M01 types.
A stale node view is reported as typed StaleState (reconciliation), never blindly retried.
UNKNOWN hardware knowledge is never coerced to a measured zero, and unknown VRAM grants no leases.
An absent IR reference universe means unknown, not 'everything resolves'.
Non-canonical incoming proof states are rejected by the invalidation bridge rather than rewritten, and kernels' ProofState is consumed rather than duplicated.
IRMigrationService defines only the bounded v1->v2 step; an unknown target version fails closed.
Combined multi-module pytest runs require --import-mode=importlib because identically named generated test files collide without __init__.py. Recorded as a finding; m06+ files were not touched.
Remaining CODEX-TASK markers were annotated with what is still open rather than deleted.

resolvedFindings: S01-INVARIANT-01: the S01-INVALIDATION task was found already implemented in invalidation.py; recorded as satisfied there instead of duplicating the traversal into invariants.py, which would either duplicate logic or create an import cycle.

S01-DEFECT-01 (found and fixed during S01): the proof-invalidation bridge documented that it rejects non-canonical proof states but did not actually check, silently rewriting them. Now validated and covered by test_proof_bridge_unknown_state_is_rejected_not_coerced.

S01-DEFECT-02 (found and fixed during S01): the route decision fingerprint was computed over a subset dict rather than the finished contract, so assert_fingerprint rejected it. Now derived from the contract itself.
S01-DEFECT-03 (found and fixed during S01): the route selector swallowed all exceptions while filtering candidates. Now only the two gate failures are caught.
S01-DEFECT-04 (found and fixed during S01): the golden slice initially omitted the graph-references-IR binding that the pure slice enforced. Restored and covered by a real test.

S01-DEFECT-05 (found and fixed during S01): the mutation harness paired a DNA-lock mutant with an M04 test and patched only defining modules, producing a false MISS. Both corrected; the harness now patches every consumer binding.

openFindings.title: combined multi-module pytest runs need --import-mode=importlib
openFindings.detail: The materializer generated identically named test files (test_contracts.py, test_service.py, test_deep_contract_surface.py) in every module's tests/ directory without __init__.py, so collecting two or more module directories at once fails with an import-file-mismatch error.
openFindings.impact: Single-module runs work unchanged; combined S01 evidence uses --import-mode=importlib, which is recorded in every command above. m06+ will hit the same issue in their own shards.
openFindings.notFixedBecause: adding __init__.py only to the five modules S01 owns would leave the rest of the program broken and would diverge from the materializer's output shape

openFindings.title: M06+ and later shards not implemented
openFindings.detail: S01 completes only M01-M05 and the foundation layer.

risks: Module error retryability changed behaviour: CapabilityUnavailable is no longer retryable. This is the correct alignment with the S00 kernel allow-list, but any pre-existing caller expecting a retry would now not get one. No in-repo caller exists yet.
The A2 golden path test is the only suite spanning packages; a change to a module service signature would surface there rather than in the per-module A1 suites.
Foundation content fingerprints exclude the declared fingerprint field at every level. A future contract that legitimately wants its declared field inside the digest would need an explicit decision.
